name: Charred plate
intro: One hot pan, one protein, and whatever's charred beside it. Peppers, zucchini, a nectarine. August's ten-minute dinner.

proteins.name: Pork chop, leftover
proteins.timing: Warmed in the hot pan, 2 minutes.

proteins.name: Halibut
proteins.timing: Seared 3–4 minutes without moving, flipped, 1–2 more.

proteins.name: Burrata and prosciutto
proteins.timing: Torn over the plate. Nothing to cook. Burrata alone for a no-meat night.

steps.text: Heat a cast-iron or heavy skillet until it smokes.
Oil and salt the pepper and zucchini, lay them in one layer, and don't move them until they blacken in spots. Flip once.
Nectarine halves in, cut side down, until they char. Move everything to the plate.
Cook or warm your protein in the same pan. Halibut: lay it in away from you and leave it until it lets go of the pan, then flip.
Your flavor over the top, and flaky salt.

leftovers: Leftover charred vegetables go into tomorrow's rice bowl.
